description:
In src/methods/email.rs:55-60, the loop
```rust
if let serde_json::Value::Object(map) = pv {
    for (k, v) in map {
        args[k] = v;
    }
}
```
blindly merges every key from the serialized EmailGetParams (including the
`#[serde(flatten)] extra` map) into the top-level args object AFTER the typed
`accountId`, `ids`, and `properties` keys have been set. A caller that puts
`{"accountId": "victim"}` (or `"ids"`, `"properties"`) into `params.extra`
will silently override the value computed from the bound session.

Trigger: any caller using EmailGetParams who puts a top-level JMAP-arg name
in extra. The workspace extras-preservation policy guarantees pass-through of
vendor fields, but the implementation here goes further and lets extras clobber
typed fields. Same pattern in `email_parse` (bd:JMAP-tjvm sibling finding).

Fix: set the typed fields AFTER the iterate-merge, or filter out reserved keys
(`accountId`, `ids`, `properties`, `blobIds`, `ifInState`) during the merge,
or reshape so EmailGetParams cannot contribute top-level args at all and the
typed builder owns key placement. The current contract is the worst of all
worlds: the merge is order-dependent and the order is wrong.
title: email_get: EmailGetParams.extra can override accountId/ids/properties
